title: MeanResidue: a Lean 4 formalization of mean quadratic residues, floor sums of square roots, and the conjectures of Chamberland and Dilcher
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the proof of the conjectures of M. Chamberland and K. Dilcher (arXiv:2510.04387, Section 7). For every n, the floor sum f(n) = sum_{j <= n/4} floor(sqrt(jn)) - (n^2-1)/12 is expressed through the mean quadratic residue S_n and the number s(n) of square roots of 0 modulo n, and (n - s(n))/2 - S_n = sum_{d | n} G(d), where G(d) is a sawtooth sum of the Moebius-inverted root counts. G vanishes on d = 1, 2 (mod 4), equals the Bernoulli form -(1/c) sum_{a<c} a (-c/a) of the class number at fundamental discriminants -c, and satisfies the conductor recursion G(l^2 c) = (l - (-c/l)) G(c) for every prime l; with Dirichlet's class number formula and the conductor formula (quoted, not formalized) this is G(c) = h*(-c). Consequences: Conjectures 7.1 (with a sign corrected), 7.2, 7.3 and 7.4 of Chamberland and Dilcher, their formulas (7.3), (7.4), Bunyakovsky's identity and Proposition 1.2, in Bernoulli form, and Conjecture 7.5 (the limits of f(n)/n), unconditionally, from the bound defect(n)^2 <= n sqrt(n) (1 + log n)^3 proved by Fourier analysis on Z/n and Weyl differencing (also, as in the note, from a class number bound stated as a hypothesis). Also: square roots modulo prime powers, including 2. The formula for S_n is the case a = 1 of Proposition A.2 of Skoruppa and Zagier (Invent. Math. 94, 1988). No sorry, no native_decide; standard axioms only.
